description: Security compliance including GDPR, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, and regulatory requirements for Java applications

questions.question: What is GDPR and how does it affect Java backend development?
questions.answer: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation): EU law protecting personal data. Applies to any organization processing EU citizens' data. Key principles: 1) Lawful basis for processing, 2) Data minimization, 3) Purpose limitation, 4) Storage limitation, 5) Right to erasure, 6) Data portability, 7) Security. Impact on development: 1) Consent management - explicit opt-in for data collection, 2) Data encryption - at rest and in transit, 3) Audit logging - who accessed what data when, 4) Data retention - automatic deletion after period, 5) Right to be forgotten - delete user data on request, 6) Data portability - export user data in standard format, 7) Privacy by design - security from start. Violations: fines up to €20M or 4% of revenue. Implementation: database soft deletes, encryption for PII, consent tracking, data export APIs, audit logs, data retention policies.
